note: one serving session on 2 GPUs: start-up dominates; replicates cost seconds each
approval_note: APPROVED_GPU_H must cover the caps (one pre-check attempt + one session attempt): the gate refuses an attempt whose full cap does not fit
why_cap_above_0_6: the session cap has to cover the slowest measured start-up (874 s) plus start-up gates, the client and the stop: 1,100 s x 2 GPUs = 0.611 GPU-h; with the 180 s pre-check cap the approval is 0.661.  A 0.60 total (session cap 990 s) would leave ~100 s after a 874 s start: replicates 5-6 would likely be dropped and a start-up slower than ~900 s would spend the attempt with no capture
